verdict.rationale: Querying raw events in-platform is a fair question for a product analytics tool, but the evidence shows no SQL or SQL-equivalent query interface inside Pendo. Data Sync only exports data to Snowflake or cloud storage, where any SQL would run in an external warehouse. Leo's natural-language questions are an adjacent feature, not a query language over raw events.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query my raw events with SQL (or an SQL-equivalent query language) inside the platform
